message:
- **You push it**, Instructions: Menu → Tasks → Export Tasks (top-right) → choose all tasks / today / custom date range, then repeat at Menu → Agents → export icon (top-right, beside Add Agent) and Menu → Analytics → set time + team + agent → export report. Each run lands as a CSV on your disk; a single task can also be pulled as a PDF via the task ID → Details → Export Task.
- **We pull it**, Instructions: log in → Menu → Settings → API Keys → generate a new key, doing this from the admin/owner account so the key sees every team's tasks rather than one manager's slice. Paste the key into a one-time link at scrt.link and email us that link, not the key itself.

Let me know if you would prefer to push this service yourself, or have us pull it.
notes: A key generated from a manager account only sees that manager's slice of tasks; the admin/owner account is required for full coverage.
Push-route exports are per-run CSVs; PDF export covers a single task at a time.
